description: Self-Renovate policy for the shared Gradle build-logic repository. Consumers inherit the shared policy from the root default.json (gitlab>magisk3171/shared/magisk-ci-toolkit preset); this file only overrides what differs for this repository. Without it the shared Renovate template fails closed: it sets requireConfig=required with onboarding=false and looks for .gitlab/renovate.json before falling back to renovate.json.
